pickupcard.config.title: Pickup Card · Settings
pickupcard.config.subtitle: Changes apply instantly — nothing to save
pickupcard.config.button.spawn.hint: Animation page: plays the sample through enter, hold and exit; other pages: places it as a static card
pickupcard.config.restore.count: Resets %s option(s) on this page; other pages untouched
pickupcard.config.restore.anchorNote: ; the anchor has its own reset in the drag editor
pickupcard.config.restore.filter: Clears all three lists (asks first) — the rules you added are removed
pickupcard.config.modal.restore.message: Clear all three lists? Every rule you added will be deleted, and this cannot be undone.
pickupcard.config.page.general.name: General
pickupcard.config.page.general.hint: Whether cards pop, what they show, and what counts as one item
pickupcard.config.page.anim.name: Animation
pickupcard.config.page.anim.hint: How quickly cards arrive and leave, and how the count animates
pickupcard.config.page.layout.name: Placement & stacking
pickupcard.config.page.layout.hint: Where cards sit, how many stack; drag cards to reposition
pickupcard.config.page.look.name: Appearance
pickupcard.config.page.look.hint: What cards look like: shape first, then colors
pickupcard.config.page.filter.name: Filter
pickupcard.config.page.filter.hint: Which items never pop, always pop, or pop quietly
pickupcard.config.row.master.name: Master switch
pickupcard.config.row.master.hint: When off, pickups don't pop cards and nothing piles up while it's off
pickupcard.config.row.showName.name: Show item name
pickupcard.config.row.showName.hint: Off leaves bar, icon and count only — cards get narrower
pickupcard.config.row.showId.name: Show item ID
pickupcard.config.row.showId.hint: The name column shows the registry ID (minecraft:stone) instead of the item name
pickupcard.config.row.nameMaxWidth.name: Max name width
pickupcard.config.row.nameMaxWidth.hint: Longer names are cut with an ellipsis; 0 = auto by screen width
pickupcard.config.row.countFormat.name: Count style
pickupcard.config.row.separation.name: Card spacing
pickupcard.config.row.separation.hint: Vertical gap between cards; the gaps inside a card are theme territory
pickupcard.config.row.mergeMode.name: Merge granularity
pickupcard.config.row.mergeMode.hint: What counts as "the same item". Click to cycle: name + enchants → name → name, but renamed splits → never merge
pickupcard.config.row.enterMs.name: Enter duration
pickupcard.config.row.enterMs.hint: How long a new card takes to slide out and settle; changing it replays the preview
pickupcard.config.row.enterToggle.name: Enter animation
pickupcard.config.row.enterToggle.hint: Only the slide-out: off makes new cards appear instantly; bump and exit are unaffected
pickupcard.config.row.appearMode.name: Entrance style
pickupcard.config.row.appearMode.hint: How a new card emerges from behind the bar. Click to cycle: Train (content slides as a block, default) → Curtain (the view wipes open) → Bounce (overshoots the end and springs back) → Drop (slides in along the train path while settling down from the anchor line, with a small landing bounce)
pickupcard.config.row.holdMs.name: Hold duration
pickupcard.config.row.holdMs.hint: How long a settled card stays before exiting; picking the same item refreshes the timer
pickupcard.config.row.sway.name: Idle sway
pickupcard.config.row.sway.hint: Off by default. On, a settled card sways gently in place for a livelier feel; only during the hold — entrance and exit are unaffected
pickupcard.config.row.exitMode.name: Exit style
pickupcard.config.row.exitMode.hint: Click to cycle: Train back (slides behind the bar, default) → Fade (in place) → Curtain close (the view wipes shut) → Fall (drops downward) → Shrink (the whole card scales away). All modes fade opacity too
pickupcard.config.row.exitMs.name: Exit duration
pickupcard.config.row.exitMs.hint: How long the exit takes; 0 = vanish the moment it's due
pickupcard.config.row.bumpToggle.name: Count bump
pickupcard.config.row.bumpToggle.hint: Repeat pickups puff the card out and roll the count to the new value
pickupcard.config.row.bumpMs.name: Bump duration
pickupcard.config.row.reviveMs.name: Fade-back duration
pickupcard.config.row.reviveMs.hint: Pick up a nearly faded card again: how long it takes to restore opacity (fully faded ones replay as new)
pickupcard.config.row.position.name: Position
pickupcard.config.row.position.hint: Opens a full-screen drag editor: grab the stack and drop it anywhere. New cards hug the anchor line, older ones push up. Stored as a screen ratio, so GUI scale changes don't shift it; cards that don't fit queue up
pickupcard.config.row.align.name: Horizontal alignment
pickupcard.config.row.align.hint: Which card edge the anchor line controls. Click to cycle: bar left edge (bars form a line) → right edge (right edges flush, left ragged). The auto anchor resolves per mode
pickupcard.config.row.mirror.name: Mirror card
pickupcard.config.row.mirror.hint: Puts the rarity bar on the right edge and runs the row right to left: icon, then name and count. Entrance and exit animations mirror too
pickupcard.config.row.scale.name: Card scale
pickupcard.config.row.scale.hint: 100% is untouched. "Auto" shrinks proportionally when the stack outgrows the anchor line, minimum 60%
pickupcard.config.row.maxOnScreen.name: Max on screen
pickupcard.config.row.maxOnScreen.hint: How many cards may show at once; what happens past a full screen follows the "When screen is full" option: replace the oldest (default) or queue
pickupcard.config.row.queueSize.name: Queue limit
pickupcard.config.row.queueSize.hint: Pickups past a full screen queue up (first in, first shown); 0 drops them instead. Queued pickups merge into the "+N more" card. Only applies when "When screen is full" is set to Queue
pickupcard.config.row.fullPolicy.name: When screen is full
pickupcard.config.row.fullPolicy.hint: What happens when a new pickup arrives with the screen full. "Replace oldest" = the new card shows up at once while the oldest card plays its exit animation to make room; "Queue" = the old behavior, the new card waits in line. "Replace oldest" never queues, so the queue limit and the "+N more" card do not apply
pickupcard.config.row.barWidth.name: Bar width
pickupcard.config.row.barWidth.hint: Thickness of the rarity bar; -1 = follow theme (default 2px)
pickupcard.config.row.paddingV.name: Icon padding
pickupcard.config.row.paddingV.hint: Space between the icon and the card's top and bottom; larger makes the card taller, icon size unchanged
pickupcard.config.row.iconSize.name: Icon size
pickupcard.config.row.iconSize.hint: Vanilla icons are 16 — multiples of 16 look crispest
pickupcard.config.row.cornerRadius.name: Corner radius
pickupcard.config.row.cornerRadius.hint: Corner radius of the three boxes; very large turns cards into capsules
pickupcard.config.row.borderWidth.name: Border width
pickupcard.config.row.fillTop.name: Fill top
pickupcard.config.row.fillTop.hint: Top of the card gradient. Click to cycle presets (first click returns to theme); exact values: fillTop in the TOML, e.g. #7DE38B
pickupcard.config.row.fillBottom.name: Fill bottom
pickupcard.config.row.fillBottom.hint: Bottom of the gradient; same as top makes it solid. Exact values: fillBottom in the TOML
pickupcard.config.row.borderColor.name: Border color
pickupcard.config.row.borderColor.hint: Outline color; exact values: border in the TOML
pickupcard.config.row.nameColor.name: Name color
pickupcard.config.row.nameColor.hint: Item name color; exact values: nameColor in the TOML
pickupcard.config.sample.common.label: Common
pickupcard.config.sample.common.hint: The most common tier — gray. Most vanilla items are here, diamonds included
pickupcard.config.sample.rare.label: Rare
pickupcard.config.sample.rare.hint: The rare tier — aqua. The sample must be truly rare: a diamond sword would just come out gray
pickupcard.config.sample.xp.label: XP
pickupcard.config.sample.xp.hint: The XP card: green is its own tier, deliberately outside rarity grading
pickupcard.config.sample.longName.label: Long name
pickupcard.config.sample.longName.hint: Epic tier — purple; also proves long names get truncated
pickupcard.config.sample.longName.custom: Enchanted Golden Apple (Treasured · from an End City)
pickupcard.config.filter.blacklist.hint: Matching items never pop — for when a beach dig would flood the screen
pickupcard.config.filter.blacklist.input: Add to blacklist: item <id> / tag #<id> / mod @<id>, press Enter
pickupcard.config.filter.whitelist.hint: Matching items always pop and get highlighted; overrides the blacklist
pickupcard.config.filter.whitelist.input: Add to whitelist: same syntax. Whitelisted = always highlighted; if also muted, still highlighted but the pickup sound is suppressed
pickupcard.config.filter.mute.hint: Matching items still pop, but their pickup sound is muted and they are not highlighted (unless whitelisted too)
pickupcard.config.filter.mute.input: Add to mute list: same syntax
pickupcard.config.filter.placeholder: Type a rule and press Enter
pickupcard.filter.reject.badSyntax: Bad syntax. Use item <id>, tag #<id>, or mod @<id>
pickupcard.filter.reject.full: A list holds at most %s rules
pickupcard.anchor.title: Card position · drag to adjust
pickupcard.anchor.autoHint: Currently: auto (bottom-right, above the HUD band) — drag the stack to make it custom
pickupcard.anchor.clamped: Card is at the margin: the anchor won't push the card past the screen edge
pickupcard.grid.title: Card overview · grid
pickupcard.grid.hint: %s columns × %s rows · %s×%s per cell · arrow keys move focus
